findings.finding: Required documents still omit the waitlist notice; adapter also omits the signature qualifier. Amount remains incomplete.
Adapter removes the baseline fabricated second quote and answers eligibility with a real source quote.
Adapter answers the immediate no-fee question but drops later quarterly-fee context from its answer.
Both omit the explicitly required booking confirmation. Adapter conditions better preserve contiguous source punctuation, but exact reference fields remain 1/8 overall.
Baseline answers the explicit prohibition; adapter returns found=false and no evidence despite sufficient document information.

limits: Eight dev tasks from two synthetic documents; exact-reference 0/8 is not semantic accuracy because valid paraphrases also fail exact matching.
Both sets of eight generations end with EOS; neither was counted as truncated.
The twelve synthetic notices have user review declarations; software cannot verify reviewer identity or depth of review.
The two held-out documents come from the same authored collection and were visible during creation/review; no test inference has been run.
No comparison to the serving Gemma model in this experiment; the baseline is native Ministral with adapter disabled.
next_direction: Add new training examples contrasting explicit prohibitions/exceptions with genuinely absent information; retain dev/test sources outside training. Do not deploy based on JSON format gains.
